name: Canvas Grid
description: Canvas grid pattern generator and applicator. generateGridPattern() renders a dot or grid pattern to a small canvas and returns a data URL. applyGridToElement() sets CSS background-image with proper scale and pan offsets. GridStyle type: 'none' | 'dots' | 'grid'.

functions.name: generateGridPattern
functions.description: Creates a small canvas with dot or grid pattern and returns a data URL.

functions.name: applyGridToElement
functions.signature: (el: HTMLElement, style: GridStyle, dataURL: string, patternSize: number, scale: number, panX: number, panY: number): void
functions.description: Sets CSS background-image, background-size, and background-position on an element for the grid pattern.

types.name: GridStyle
types.description: Visual style of the canvas background grid.
